{{Top|fprot|mprot}}

:→ <small>See [[Forum:CT:Partner Field CT - Part the Second]]</small>

*Additions to the partners field should meet at least '''one''' of the following criteria:
**Individuals defined as spouses, fiancés, or life partners.
**Individuals defined or described as "lovers" or "paramours," or defined as "partners" in a romantic context not solely relying on a business relationship.
**Individuals defined as a "boyfriend," "girlfriend," or shown/described in an in-universe context as in a non-fling relationship that would fall under the definition of "significant other."
**Individuals defined as co-parenting a child as part of the same family or familial-like unit can be denoted as a co-parent.
**Individuals defined as one of the above by additional context provided by a ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator, pursuant to the [[Wookieepedia:Canon policy|canon policy]].
**All additions should be defined using {{Tl|C}}, denoting the [[in-universe]] terminology used to define the relationship.
**Examples:
***Spouses/Fiancés:
****Example #1:
*****[[Padmé Amidala]] {{C|[[Marriage|wife]]}}
*****[[Anakin Skywalker]] {{C|[[Marriage|husband]]}}
*****Defined as married in the [[prequel trilogy]].
****Example #2:
*****[[Beesar Tal-Apurna]] {{C|[[Marriage|wife]]}}
*****[[Teemank]] {{C|[[Marriage|wife]]}}
*****Defined as married in [[The High Republic: Trail of Shadows 4|''The High Republic: Trail of Shadows'' 4]].
****Example #3:
*****[[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] {{C|fiancé}}
*****[[Karreio]] {{C|fiancé}}
*****Defined as fiancés by [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']].
****Individuals should be denoted by {{C|husband}}, {{C|wife}}, {{C|spouse}}, {{C|fiancé}}, {{C|partner}}, and/or other in-universe terminology used to define characters' relationships to each other.
***Partners/lovers:
****Example #1:
*****[[Quinlan Vos]] {{C|lover}}
*****[[Asajj Ventress]] {{C|lover}}
*****Defined as lovers in ''[[Dark Disciple]]''.
****Example #2:
*****[[Thirteenth Sister]] {{C|lover}}
*****[[Tualon Yaluna]] {{C|lover}}
*****Defined as lovers in ''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]''.
****Example #3:
*****[[Fel Ix]] {{C|partner}}
*****[[Ferize]] {{C|partner}}
*****[[Er Dal]] {{C|partner}}
*****Defined as partners in ''[[The High Republic: Path of Deceit]]'' and other sources. Due to the specific nature of [[Kessarine]] gender dynamics, each individual in the relationship refers to the other two as their fellow partners, whom they are forming a family with in a relationship.
****Example #4:
*****[[Rhee]] {{C|partner}}
*****[[Eron]] {{C|partner}}
*****Defined as in an [https://web.archive.org/web/20231104054457/https://wilwheaton.tumblr.com/post/733005025269448704/hi-wil-in-your-star-wars-story-laina-are-the established, loving] relationship as a romantic couple by [[Wil Wheaton]].
****Individuals should be denoted by the in-universe terminology used to define their relationship, including terms such as {{C|lover}}, {{C|boyfriend}}, {{C|girlfriend}}, {{C|partner}}, or otherwise.
****Individuals whose relationship was further defined by a ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator pursuant to the pursuant to the [[Wookieepedia:Canon policy|canon policy]] may list their relationship in the infobox with the best fitting descriptor applied.
***Significant others
****Example #1:
*****[[Ariole Yu]] {{C|boyfriend}}
*****[[Just Lucky]] {{C|boyfriend}}
*****Defined as in a committed relationship in [[Star Wars: Doctor Aphra (2020)|''Star Wars: Doctor Aphra'']], at one point serious enough for Just Lucky to propose to his boyfriend.
****Example #2:
*****[[Yana Ro]] {{C|girlfriend}}
*****[[Kor Plouth]] {{C|girlfriend}}
*****Defined as in a committed relationship of several years in ''[[The High Republic: Path of Deceit]]''.
****Example #3:
*****[[Kantam Sy]] {{C|lover}}
*****[[Aytar]] {{C|lover}}
*****Defined as a relatively short relationship, but also a serious one that prompted Sy's leaving of the [[Jedi Order]] and in which the pair lived together, in ''[[The High Republic: Midnight Horizon]]''.
****Example #4:
*****[[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] {{C|girlfriend}}
*****[[Kier Domadi]] {{C|boyfriend}}
*****Defined as each other's first serious romantic relationship&mdash;spanning for roughly a year&mdash;in ''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]''.
****Example #5:
*****[[Borgin Kaa]] {{C|boyfriend}}
*****[[Linara]] {{C|girlfriend}}
*****Defined as boyfriend/girlfriend and cohabitating in [[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']].
****Example #6:
*****[[Qui-Gon Jinn]] {{C|partner}}
*****[[Unidentified individual (Qui-Gon Jinn)]] {{C|partner}}
*****Defined by [[Claudia Gray]] in an [https://web.archive.org/web/20200227051833/https://toschestation.net/dragon-con-2019-e-k-johnston-and-claudia-gray-talk-the-prequels interview] as a serious romantic relationship lasting for a period of time that fundamentally affected Qui-Gon Jinn's worldview.
****Individuals should be denoted by the appropriate descriptor using {{Tl|C}} when they are described in-universe as having been in a romantic relationship that is ''not'' a fling, one-night stand, or a relationship explicitly described as similar to either. 
***Co-parents
****Example #1:
*****[[Hamato Xiono]] {{C|co-[[parent]]}}
*****[[Kazuda Xiono's mother]] {{C|co-[[parent]]}}
*****Defined by [https://www.starwars.com/databank/kazuda-kaz-xiono Kazuda Xiono's Databank entry] as co-parents raising him within the [[Xiono family]].
****Example #2:
*****[[Phel and Sana Starros' father]] {{C|co-[[parent]]}}
*****[[Jorinda]] {{C|co-[[parent]]}}
*****Defined by [[Sana Starros 1|''Sana Starros'' 1]] as having raised their children [[Phel Starros|Phel]] and [[Sana Starros]] together.
****Individuals should be denoted by {{C|co-[[parent]]}} when they are described in-universe as having raised a child together as part of the same family. This does not necessarily apply to all physical unions that result in a child or all intimate partners of a character but rather when two characters maintain a prolonged relationship with each other within a family, clan, or other familial-like unit to raise their biological or adopted child.
*Examples of instances that '''would not''' be in the infobox, but rather in the article's prose:
**Individuals explicitly described as engaging in a one-night stand or fling.
***Example: [[Elzar Mann]] and [[Samera Ra-oon]] developed a brief romantic relationship in ''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]'', described in-universe as not a serious relationship and a fling.
**Non-reciprocated crushes and attractions.
***Example: An [[Unidentified Imperial nurse|Imperial nurse]] was romantically obsessed with and stalked [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in [[Vader - Dark Visions 3|''Vader - Dark Visions'' 3]], though he displayed no interest in her and ultimately killed her.
**Reciprocated crushes and attractions that do not result in the characters engaging in any form of relationship.
***Example: [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Satine Kryze]]&mdash;in various sources&mdash;fell in love with each other and the former was willing to leave the [[Jedi Order]] for her. However, neither began a relationship despite their attractions for any length of time.
**Relationships that span a particularly short period of time&mdash;such as less than a week.
***Example: [[Svi'no Atchapat]] and [[Tivbak]] are described in ''[[The High Republic: Midnight Horizon]]'' as having dated for "like ten minutes," rendering their relationship extremely brief.
**Relationships described by the ''[[Star Wars]]'' contributor of the relevant material as explicitly platonic in nature.
***Example: [[Padmé Amidala]] and [[Sabé]] per [[E. K. Johnston]] in an [https://web.archive.org/web/20200227051833/https://toschestation.net/dragon-con-2019-e-k-johnston-and-claudia-gray-talk-the-prequels/ interview].
**Relationships that are created by individuals as part of a ruse for infiltration, disguise, or otherwise unless sources describe the individuals as entering into a relationship that is not part of their created facade.
***Example: [[Colvett Valeria]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] briefly pretended to be a couple to fool Imperials and those in Jabba's Palace in ''[[LEGO Star Wars Summer Vacation]]''.
*Examples of instances that '''may''' be in the infobox on a case-by-case basis alongside their inclusion in the article's prose, but may be challenged:
**Relationships that span a short period of time.
**Relationships described in-universe as the character not considering them "serious" or similar.
